about: Mobic (meloxicam, an NSAID) is supplied four times from January 2026 to April 2026 while Cartia 100 mg (low-dose aspirin) is supplied throughout, both by brand name only, and no stomach-protection medicine (proton pump inhibitor or H2 blocker) is supplied at any time.

Naprosyn (naproxen) is supplied three times from February 2026 to March 2026 in the middle of a 15-month history while Lexapro (escitalopram, an SSRI) is supplied every four weeks, and no proton pump inhibitor or H2 blocker is ever supplied.

Naprosyn SR (naproxen) is supplied with low-dose aspirin (Cartia) from December 2025, but pantoprazole (Somac, a proton pump inhibitor) is supplied every month before and throughout, so stomach protection is provided.
